caveats: Unemployment is a percentage of the labour force within the reported sex and geography, not a share of the whole working-age population. Provincial rates cannot be averaged to obtain the national rate. The source flags North Central female unemployment in 2024, North Central male unemployment in 2025, Sabaragamuwa male unemployment in 2025 and Eastern male unemployment in 2024 because of high coefficients of variation. No confidence intervals are supplied in this summary. The 2025 annual report says 2025 estimates were reweighted using the 2024 Census; the Pocket Book does not document a comparable reweighting for earlier years.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One province or national unemployment rate, sex and year
notes: Annual DCS Labour Force Survey unemployment rates for 2022–2025, compiled in the Pocket Book. The data covers nine provinces and the national figure, with male, female and both-sex rates for the household population aged 15 and over. Four blue-shaded source cells are identified with a sampling-caution flag. The original 2025 annual report supplies the weighting-method context.
